boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Documented University of San Francisco rituals, cultural celebrations, and annual gatherings.

cards.title: Howl at the moon
cards.subtitle: New-student orientation tradition
cards.notes: During orientation, join fellow new Dons in the Night Howl and howl at the moon in hopes of a strong first semester.
cards.short_summary: USF identifies this orientation ritual as its oldest tradition.
cards.evidence_claim: USF’s orientation guide calls the Night Howl its oldest tradition and says new students howl at the moon in hopes of a perfect first semester.
cards.access_notes: Held during new-student orientation; participation details are provided by orientation programming.

cards.title: Donaroo
cards.subtitle: Annual spring music festival
cards.notes: Check Campus Activities Board announcements for Donaroo’s lineup and attend the annual spring music festival on the Hilltop.
cards.short_summary: A spring festival that evolved from USF’s former Fall Fest.
cards.evidence_claim: USF reports that Donaroo began as Fall Fest during homecoming week in 2007, moved to spring in 2013, and received its current name the next year.
cards.access_notes: Annual event; consult current Campus Activities Board announcements for date and entry details.

cards.entity_name: USF Night at the Ballpark Giants Game
cards.title: USF Night at the Ballpark
cards.subtitle: Oracle Park gathering each spring
cards.notes: Watch for the spring USF–Giants event, then join Dons at Oracle Park and pick up the event’s USF/Giants swag.
cards.short_summary: A spring gathering that connects USF with the San Francisco Giants.
cards.evidence_claim: USF states that each spring it and the San Francisco Giants offer Dons a night at Oracle Park with USF/Giants swag.
cards.access_notes: Annual spring event at Oracle Park; ticket and attendance arrangements vary by year.

cards.entity_name: Incoming Class Year Photo on Welch Field
cards.title: Take the class-year photo
cards.subtitle: Welch Field first-year gathering
cards.notes: When your first-year class is called to Welch Field, join the group on the lawn for the aerial class photo.
cards.short_summary: First-year Dons form a class image on the lawn between the church and Kalmanovitz Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: USF says first-year Dons gather on the Welch Field lawn between St. Ignatius Church and Kalmanovitz Hall for a drone-captured aerial group photo.
cards.access_notes: Scheduled for incoming students; follow orientation communications for timing.

cards.title: Tri Gamma Fashion Show
cards.subtitle: USF student fashion-show tradition
cards.notes: Look for the Tri Gamma Fashion Show in campus event listings and attend to support the student presentation and its participants.
cards.short_summary: A named student fashion-show tradition recorded in USF’s traditions feature.
cards.evidence_claim: USF includes the Tri Gamma Fashion Show among its traditions, customs, and ceremonies.
cards.access_notes: Event timing and attendance details vary; consult current campus event listings.

cards.title: Philippine Cultural Night
cards.subtitle: Annual heritage showcase
cards.notes: Attend Philippine Cultural Night to experience student performances including skits, traditional dance, music, and spoken word.
cards.short_summary: An annual Dons showcase of Philippine-heritage performance.
cards.evidence_claim: USF describes Philippine Cultural Night as an annual event featuring Dons with Philippine heritage in skits, traditional dances, music including rondalla, and spoken word.
cards.access_notes: Annual event; consult current student-organization programming for attendance information.

cards.title: Hui O Hawai‘i Hō‘ike
cards.subtitle: Hawaiian cultural club’s annual gathering
cards.notes: Follow Hui O Hawai‘i for its annual hō‘ike, where mele, mea ‘ai, and hula support cultural storytelling and education.
cards.short_summary: A Hawaiian cultural-club tradition first celebrated in 1974.
cards.evidence_claim: USF reports that Hui O Hawai‘i first celebrated its annual event in 1974 and renamed it hō‘ike to emphasize storytelling through song, food, and hula.
cards.access_notes: Annual cultural event; consult the club’s current programming for details.

cards.title: Begin the year at Mass of the Holy Spirit
cards.subtitle: Fall-semester Jesuit ceremony
cards.notes: At the beginning of fall semester, gather with the USF community for the Mass of the Holy Spirit and the year’s shared reflection.
cards.short_summary: USF’s fall opening ceremony draws on a Jesuit-school practice dating to 1548.
cards.evidence_claim: USF states that Jesuit schools have begun the academic year with this special Mass since 1548, and Dons gather each fall semester for guidance, wisdom, and inspiration.
cards.access_notes: Held at the start of fall semester; consult university liturgy and academic calendars.

cards.title: Commencement at St. Ignatius
cards.subtitle: Graduation ceremony and Welch Field celebration
cards.notes: For graduation, follow ceremony instructions at St. Ignatius Church, then celebrate with classmates outside on Welch Field.
cards.short_summary: USF pairs church commencement with a celebratory gathering on Welch Field.
cards.evidence_claim: USF describes graduates lining up in St. Ignatius Church and then celebrating outside on Welch Field after commencement.
cards.access_notes: For graduating students and invited guests; follow official commencement instructions.

cards.title: CelebrateUSF
cards.subtitle: Annual fall campus celebration
cards.notes: Plan around CelebrateUSF in the fall and use the published schedule to choose campus events with students, families, alumni, and friends.
cards.short_summary: A multi-day fall tradition welcoming the wider USF community back to the Hilltop.
cards.evidence_claim: USF calls CelebrateUSF one of its biggest traditions and describes it as an annual fall event for alumni, parents, families, faculty, staff, students, and friends.
cards.source_title: 9 Highlights from a Milestone: USF’s 5th CelebrateUSF
cards.access_notes: Annual fall event; consult the current CelebrateUSF schedule for individual-event access details.
